titles.romaji: Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe
titles.native: 装甲騎兵ボトムズ 灰色の魔女

description:
The story of Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe is set during the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy. Against this backdrop, army officer Maki Staufenberg is assigned to Valkyria II, the second planet in the Asgard system, where she is tasked with investigating Ash Vamps, a soldier who has earned the nickname of “Witch” because of her habit of being the sole survivor in missions assigned to her ragtag band of soldiers on punishment detail.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

Note: Relations are provisional and subject to change.
